title: StatusResponse
description:
`GET /v1/status`: today's admission state, from the `Control` object.

The field order is fixed and is the wire order: the day and the sandbox count and cap
(PR 2), then the guest and demo-account counts and caps (PR 3), then the status page's
counters with their time and state (PR 13), then the flag. Readers go by name, so PR 2's
smoke check still passes; a new field is added before `flag`.

The counters are a snapshot of the kept Analytics Engine queries that the 15-minute cron
refreshes, never a query per request (docs/operations.md, "Observability").

counters.description: The last snapshot of the kept queries; `null` until the first refresh succeeds.

counters_as_of.description:
When that snapshot was taken, an RFC 3339 UTC time such as `2026-11-06T10:15:02.114Z`;
`null` with `counters`.

counters_state.description: Whether the counters are fresh: `live`, `stale` or `unavailable`.

day.description: Today's UTC date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the key of the daily ledger.

demo_account_cap.description: The most demo accounts created in one UTC day.

guest_cap.description: The guests' share of the day's sandboxes.

sandbox_cap.description: The most sandboxes admitted in one UTC day.

oneOf.description:
An older snapshot: the last refresh failed, or none has run for 20 minutes. The
failure's reason is in the Worker's log only.

Flag.description: The demo's mode, set in `Control` (kill switch L1).

oneOf.description: Only the storefront's static pages work.

LastWipe.description: One nightly wipe, as its `wipe` point recorded it.

at.description:
When the point was written, at the wipe's end: an RFC 3339 UTC time such as
`2026-11-06T10:00:04Z`.

ms.description: Milliseconds from the 10:00 UTC cron to the wipe's last run.

objects.description: Objects those sandboxes emptied, each Sandbox and its children.

StatusCounters.description:
The status page's counters: the kept Analytics Engine queries over the last 24 hours, and
the last nightly wipe (docs/operations.md, "Observability"). Counts are sums of the points'
sample intervals, so they stay counts when Analytics Engine samples.

dlq_24h.description: `dlq` points in the last 24 hours: messages the dead-letter writer kept.

last_wipe.description: The latest `wipe` point; `null` when none is in the dataset.

sandboxes_24h.description: `sandbox_created` points in the last 24 hours, to read against the daily cap.
